newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat near 1,600 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat near 1,600 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed near 1,600 per dollar, unchanged from the opening and from Wednesday's close at 1,580-1,610, after quiet, rangebound interbank trade, dealers said.

"Trade was very quiet. Final clients were bidding for small dollar volumes, and there was interest for foreign currency sales also from clients due to which the lev consolidatd between 1,590-1,610," one dealer said.
The longer value date of Thursday's spot deals did not trigger the usual lev drop because dollar supply was large enough to meet demand, traders said.
